message.content: The UI appears clean and well-structured with no obvious visual defects. The layout includes a top search bar, a greeting header, a prominent featured card promoting interactive experiences, a "Your stats" section showing metrics (9 moments sent, 87% open rate, 34 loves), and a "Continue Creating" section. A bottom navigation bar provides access to Home, Create, Explore, Gallery, and Profile. All elements are properly aligned, text is fully visible, and components are well-spaced without overlapping or cut-off issues.
